test_title: PYST 36: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 12 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Town X is to the west of Town Y. Town Z is to the north of Town Y. Town W is to the west of Town Z. Town V is to the south of Town W. Town X is to the north-west of Town V. What is the position of Town X with respect to Town W?
solution:
**Given:** Town X is to the west of Town Y. Town Z is to the north of Town Y. Town W is to the west of Town Z. Town V is to the south of Town W. Town X is to the north-west of Town V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcdd06108c3684e6b56af65e4e059890161b8f3c1b037676c66a3297428e44e9.png] 

Thus, Town X is to the South-west of Town W.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
